articles.title: Disney CEO Succession Vote Puts Valuation And Future Priorities In Focus
articles.mainIdea: Disney CEO Succession Vote Puts Valuation And Future Priorities In Focus
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Disney CEO Succession Vote Puts Valuation And Future Priorities In Focus. Disney (NYSE:DIS) is approaching a key leadership moment as Bob Iger prepares to step down as CEO. The board of directors is expected to vote on his successor in the coming days. The outcome could influence how the company approaches film, streaming, parks, and licensing in the years ahead. For a company with global reach across film studios, streaming platforms, theme parks, and consumer products, a CEO handover is more than a headline change. It represents a shift in who sets priorities...

articles.mainIdea: Kendrick Lamar, Bad Bunny, Lady Gaga face off at Grammys
articles.summary: AFP: Kendrick Lamar, Bad Bunny, Lady Gaga face off at Grammys. Music's A-listers are set for Sunday's Grammy Awards, the industry's biggest night, with superstars Kendrick Lamar, Bad Bunny and Lady Gaga hoping to make history in Los Angeles.A win on Sunday would give Bad Bunny another mention in the history books.
